public_rationale: Contemporaneous commentary described fading hype, and later reporting describes an expectations-related Chinese technology-stock decline. Neither establishes the near-term, broad generative-AI financial deflation and cause predicted here. The October 2026 decline is more than two years after the post and cannot by itself vindicate 'imminent'. The wording supplies no defensible exact deadline for a binary timing verdict.
limitations: The result depends on whether 'bubble deflation' means financial contraction or declining enthusiasm.
The recent market account is secondary and covers a different sector composition.
An unresolved result does not mean that the near-term prediction was demonstrated.

conditions: caused by recognition that GenAI can't meet expectations

statement.excerpt: When the bubble deflation that I have been predicting comes, as now seems imminent, it will come because so many people have begun to recognize that GenAI can’t live up to expectations.
statement.document_title: This one important fact about current AI explains almost everything

from_speaker: When the bubble deflation that I have been predicting comes
because so many people have begun to recognize

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading predicts a near-term reduction in generative-AI speculative enthusiasm and financial valuations, caused materially by disappointed expectations about its capabilities.
'Imminent' signals near-term timing but supplies no latest calendar date. I do not invent a three-, six- or twelve-month deadline.
The sentence predicts both the downturn and its cause. Recognition of unmet expectations is the predicted mechanism, not a separate prerequisite that must occur before the forecast applies.
A financial deflation is distinguished from a change in commentary or hype alone.
criteria.support_condition: A broad and sustained generative-AI valuation or financing contraction occurs near the post, and evidence links it materially to recognition that the technology cannot meet expectations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A qualifying deflation occurs but credible causal evidence rules out disappointment in generative-AI capabilities as a material cause. A precise timing failure requires a deadline that the text does not supply.

evidence.explanation: Other authors described declining hype shortly after Marcus's post. That contemporaneous interpretation does not itself establish a sustained financial contraction or its cause.

evidence.locator: Paragraph explaining the Chinese technology-stock decline
evidence.explanation: This reports an expectations-related decline in Chinese AI and semiconductor shares, alongside export-policy concerns. Its geography, hardware-heavy scope and timing do not establish an imminent generative-AI deflation after August 2024.

Anthropic reported continuing expansion well after the prediction. One company's expansion does not settle sector-wide valuations, but it cautions against assuming that the predicted deflation had already occurred.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A dated sector-wide contraction with contemporaneous evidence of its cause would settle the event-and-cause component. A precise timing verdict additionally requires a defensible interpretation of 'imminent'.
